Lyubashivka New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Odessa Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Lyubashivka's Jewish population reached about 200 families by the early 20th century, served by Rabbi Shmuel-Zeev Shechter (born 1875) during the late 19th and early 20th century. A 1919 pogrom by Volunteer Army detachments prompted some Jews to flee to Ivanovka, leaving only 50 to 60 families afterward; by 1939, the population had recovered to 671. Following the summer 1941 occupation and ghetto's establishment, about 350 Jews were executed in September 1941. This cemetery, established in the 1910s, holds mostly postwar gravestones, with older stones presumably brought from Lyubashivka's old cemetery.
